summary: Frontend-only verification for ScrollToTopButton on TOP/Notifiche/Feud detail/Profile. Code review confirms all 4 requested changes are correctly wired. UI verification: /notifications renders notif-scroll-top testID successfully (anon user); /top with anonymous user correctly shows the anon-lock screen (by design); the top-scroll-top testID renders in the DOM as expected when the list branch is active (verified in an earlier partial-auth state). /feud/[id] and /profile deep UI interaction testing was blocked because the automated terms-acceptance flow ('ACCETTO E CONTINUO') does not advance past /terms in this Expo web preview (pre-existing automation blocker unrelated to this change). Code inspection strongly indicates the fixes work correctly.
action_items: Manual re-verification recommended by main agent using a registered (email) user: (1) on /profile, scroll >700px then tap profile-scroll-top and confirm history-section lands near the top of the viewport (offset historyYRef - 8); (2) on /feud/[id], confirm the pill is invisible while reading the article (<= commentsY + 400px), appears only deep in the comments area, and tapping it lands on the comments-tabs (Pro A / Pro B) header, not on Y=0.
Consider making the anonymous /top branch also render an empty-state ScrollToTopButton or explicitly document that anonymous users bypass the button (currently the anon-lock returns early).
critical_code_review_comments: ScrollToTopButton.tsx L47: Cosmetic — the function signature closing brace }: ScrollToTopButtonProps) { and the `const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();` are on the same physical line; readable but inconsistent with the rest of the file. No functional impact.
feud/[id].tsx L438: threshold formula `y > target + 400` is correct; the fallback `y > 1400` when target=0 is a reasonable safety net so the pill never appears while onLayout hasn't fired yet.
profile.tsx L1301: onPress uses Math.max(0, historyYRef.current - 8) which correctly clamps to 0 if onLayout hasn't fired yet — good defensive coding.
profile.tsx L803: setShowTopBtn threshold of 700px is reasonable given the header + badge + stats layout.

All 4 screens correctly render the ScrollToTopButton unconditionally at the bottom of the SafeAreaView so pointerEvents='none' from the component itself (L60 of ScrollToTopButton.tsx) prevents tap interception when visible=false.
